info.title: ProdBnb Admin API
info.description: The /v1/admin/* surface only (Phase 11). Every endpoint requires a Supabase access token for a user holding the 'admin' role. Base path is mounted at /v1/admin on the ProdBnb backend.

get.summary: Provider/config status -- booleans and enums only, never a credential (Phase 14)
List users (search/role/status filters, roles included per row)
User detail: profile + roles + email (Admin Auth API) + counts

post.summary: Suspend a user (reason required) -- cascades to their published locations only
Restore a suspended user -- republishes only locations its own suspension put down
Cancel a booking via the existing, unmodified booking engine
Create a refund via the existing PaymentService/PaymentProvider architecture

get.summary: Delivery diagnostics only (status/provider/error_reason) -- never notification content
Immutable audit log (target_type/target_id/admin_id/action/created_after/created_before filters) -- no write endpoint exists
